question_text: From your reading of the above passage fill in the blanks with
stimulus: suitable words. Use one word only in each blank. 15=5 Begum Sufia Kamal was the daughter of Abdul Bari (a) ⎯ was a lawyer. She took education at home. She went to Kolkata with her mother at her (b) ⎯ age and there she met Rokeya Sakhawat Hossain. Her first story "Sainik Bahadur" was published in the Tarun. Her first book of poems "Sanjher Maya" got much (c) ⎯ from Kazi Nazrul Islam and Rabindranath Tagore. Later on, she (d) ⎯ many short stories, poems and an autobiography. She got many awards (e) ⎯ "Ekushey Padak", the Independence Award etc.
